etsy.title: Family Emergency Binder Printable with Pet and Kids Pages, Emergency Plan Template, 72 Hour Kit Checklist, Emergency Contact List
etsy.description:
When something unexpected happens, nobody wants to search for phone numbers or wonder where the kids should go. This printable binder puts your whole family plan in one calm place, including your pets and wallet cards for the kids. 🏠

✨ WHAT'S INSIDE (8 pages)
• Family contacts and medical info: allergies, medicines, doctors, out-of-area contact
• Family emergency plan: meeting places, how you reach each other, exits, utility shut-offs, who picks up the kids
• 72-hour emergency kit checklist (based on the basic kit recommended at Ready.gov)
• Pet emergency page: two pet profiles, microchip, vet, pet go-bag checklist
• Kids' emergency wallet cards (4 per page) + "I know what to do" practice checklist
• Documents location list + review log
• How-to page with tips for practicing your plan

👨‍👩‍👧 For families with kids and pets. Fill it in by hand in one evening, keep it by the door and take a photo of each page for your phone.

HOW IT WORKS
INSTANT DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. US Letter + A4 PDF included.

PLEASE NOTE
A planning aid, not medical, legal, veterinary or emergency advice. In an emergency call 911 (US) or 112 (EU). For personal use only. Please do not resell or share the files.

Designed by our small shop, AureliaVenn, with the help of AI tools.
